caption: The drawing is on a rectangular piece of paper with a beige or light tan background. In the center, there is a blue illustration that appears to depict two curved objects, similar to stylized wings or leaves, meeting at a central point. Above and overlapping the blue illustration are the words "C. CROLIUS" and "NEW-YORK" in uppercase letters, with "C. CROLIUS" positioned above and following a slight upward arc, and "NEW-YORK" below it, following a slight downward arc. The text is rendered in a serif font and is uncolored, exposing the background. There are several small brown or rust-colored spots scattered around the drawing, particularly near the center. The entire image is bordered by a wide cream-colored mat, and there is a small, faint inscription with the text "Mrs. Casneau" in the lower left corner of the mat.
title: Jug
